statement: Under the declared L1 NVML boundary, GPTQ reduces mWh per forced 512 completion tokens by more than 2% relative to AWQ.

boundary.energy: NVML GPU board-power telemetry integrated over concurrent request windows on two RTX 5090 GPUs.
boundary.service: Eight concurrent fixed-prompt requests per format session, forced to 512 completion tokens.

threshold_rationale.status: post-collection illustrative L1 screen; not a universal default

required_gate_set_complete.evidence: current release registry comparison is performed by the evaluator.

runtime_provenance_status.evidence: Driver, firmware, power cap, clock policy, temperature trace and immutable runtime commit were not preserved.

design_integrity.evidence: The physical-GPU mapping changed once after block 5, while direction reverses by phase.

mapping_period_separability.evidence: Map, period and unrecorded platform state cannot be separated.

serial_dependence_assessed.evidence: Ten sequential blocks and one map exchange do not support a reliable serial-dependence assessment.

integration_stability.evidence: p95 stride-2 absolute difference 0.0414 percentage points.

benefit_threshold.evidence: The historical pooled upper one-sided bound was 1.249%, below the 2% claim threshold; retained as an audit tag only.

dependence_compatible_interval.evidence: The historical iid t interval was not predeclared or shown compatible with potential block dependence.

permitted_wording: Not assessable with available evidence: the one-time mapping exchange, unpreserved platform state and unassessed dependence structure violate L1 dependencies; pooled estimates are audit tags only.
prohibited_wording: GPTQ is contradicted as a configuration effect
